Require --yes confirmation for standalone remove commands

remove_from_wantlist/remove_from_collection take confirm= and, without it, raise ConfirmationRequiredError after resolving the target; no removal API call is made. The preview names release_id, artist, title, and for collections the instance_id and copies owned.
wantlist remove / collection remove gain --yes. Without it the CLI prints the preview (JSON with --output-format json) and exits 2.
Unconfirmed sync --remove-extras now raises the same ConfirmationRequiredError so every destructive entry point shares one confirmation model.
SKILL.md agent rules: preview without --yes, get user approval, re-run with --yes. README and CLAUDE.md updated.
Tests verify no removal call happens without confirmation.

Address ClawHub SkillSpector security findings

Remove runtime venv bootstrap (subprocess pip install + os.execv) from discogs-sync.py; check imports instead and pick up an optional ~/.discogs-sync/venv. No subprocess/exec/eval/import remains.
Pin all dependencies (including transitive) to exact versions; bump to 0.2.0.
Drop OAuth 1.0a; personal access token only. DISCOGS_USER_TOKEN env var takes precedence over config.json. Hide token prompt input; create the config dir owner-only.
--remove-extras now refuses without --yes (or --dry-run) and aborts if any input record failed to resolve, both before any write. Single removes print what they delete.
SKILL.md: declare token/primaryEnv and network scope, add Security & Permissions section and agent confirmation rules, remove auto-install, OAuth, and chmod text. Update README and CLAUDE.md.
Tests for token precedence, hidden prompt, removal guards, and the real entry point.

## v0.1.5

- Added support for `--format` and `--year` filters to `wantlist list` and `collection list` commands.
- Documentation updated to reflect new filtering options for listing wantlist and collection items.

No file changes detected for version 0.1.4.

- Version bump with no user-facing changes.
- No updates to code or documentation.

- Now installs Python dependencies automatically in a local virtualenv on first run; manual pip install is no longer needed.
- Updated requirements: dropped explicit runtime check for pip3; only Python 3 required system-wide.
- Installation and update instructions in documentation reflect new zero-manual-setup workflow.
- Skill metadata updated to remove dependency on pip3 and clarify binary requirements.

- Added local filesystem cache for wantlist, collection, and marketplace search results to reduce API calls and speed up repeated queries.
- New `--no-cache` flag for list and marketplace search commands to bypass cache when fresh data is needed.
- Added `--country` and `--release-id` options to marketplace search for more precise filtering and release-specific stats.
- Marketplace search now supports a `--details` flag to include suggested prices by condition grade, with cache integration for faster repeat lookups.
- Updated help and documentation to reflect new caching and CLI features.

- Added requirements.txt specifying dependencies for easier setup with pip.
- Updated SKILL.md to include installation instructions and required dependencies using requirements.txt or direct pip install.
- Changed metadata to list both python3 and pip3 as required binaries.
- No functional changes to core logic; usage remains the same.

Initial public release of discogs-sync.

- Add and remove albums from Discogs wantlist or collection by artist/album name, master ID, or release ID
- Search Discogs marketplace pricing for vinyl, CD, and other formats
- List contents of your wantlist and collection with filtering and output format options
- Supports bulk operations (add/remove/sync/search) via CSV or JSON file input
- Authentication via personal access token or OAuth 1.0a
- Duplicate checks and bulk operation previewing with --dry-run available
